title: skops-format sklearn models must be blocked by MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false like pickle
answers: skops model loads even though MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION is false
sklearn skops format bypasses the pickle deserialization guard
how do I stop mlflow loading a model that can run arbitrary code when deserialization is disallowed
skops trusted types allow-list read from MLmodel lets crafted model execute code
body:
Symptom: a user sets MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false, follows the error's advice to save the model in skops format, and a crafted sklearn/lightgbm model still executes code on load.
Root cause: mlflow/sklearn/__init__.py:_load_model_from_local_file wrapped the deserialization guard in `if serialization_format != SERIALIZATION_FORMAT_SKOPS`, so skops skipped it. skops' `trusted` allow-list comes from the model's own MLmodel, so it cannot be trusted.
Fix pattern: run the MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION check once, before any per-format branch in _load_model_from_local_file, and do not exempt any serialization format. Reword the raised error so it does not recommend skops as a safe alternative.
Constraints: default flag is true, so default behavior is unchanged. The is_in_databricks_runtime / is_in_databricks_model_serving_environment carve-outs are pre-existing and shared with pickle/cloudpickle; keep them consistent across formats. Loading from an untrusted source stays unsafe in any format.
applies: Any model-loading path in mlflow/sklearn (and flavors that reuse its loader) that reads a serialized artifact; not for save-time behavior.
says: Untrusted model files still execute code even when unsafe deserialization is disabled.
Prevent model loading from running arbitrary code when deserialization protection is turned on.
Disabling deserialization fails to block untrusted models saved in the alternative format.
Model loading error message incorrectly recommends an alternative format that remains unsafe.
Block all unsafe model formats when the setting to disallow deserialization is active.
search: In mlflow/sklearn/__init__.py:_load_model_from_local_file, the MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false security check must execute before any format-specific branching and apply to skops format rather than exempting it. The skops format trusted allow-list comes from the model's MLmodel file and cannot be trusted against arbitrary code execution. The error message must be updated to avoid recommending skops as a safe alternative, while preserving existing Databricks runtime and model serving environment carve-outs. This applies to all model-loading paths in mlflow/sklearn and derivative flavors reading serialized artifacts, leaving the default enabled flag unchanged.
